description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Bootleggers' Stash by tapping it, as it's a land due to Toph, creating two Treasure tokens due to Kaya, Geist Hunter.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Bootleggers' Stash.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Kaya, Geist Hunter
uses.cardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
